name: copy-editing
description: Editing tools for prose you already have, from help articles and notices to reports and policies. A final proof that fixes only real slips, checks dates against weekdays, stated counts against lists and percentages against their total, and compares a final text with the approved one for a ship-or-hold verdict. A copyedit at the level you pick, light by default, with questions to the author instead of guesses. A style sheet and word list built from your own documents, with every variant counted and conflicting facts flagged. A cut to an exact word or character count with a ledger of what was removed. A refresh of one published page that lists every dated item and never invents a newer figure. Numbers, names and quotations keep their values. Checks are tuned for English.
